senses.gloss: (Mus.), איפומטא, איפומניטא, איפומג׳ &c. (read: אֶיפִּיטִימְיָא) m. pl. (ἐπιτίμια, τὰ) the imposed penalty, sentence.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 77:3">Yalk. Gen. 77</cite>; Ex. 167. [Mus. reads <he>נקרית</he> sing. fem. = ἐπιτιμία.]
